motion.name: fast

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary workflow action with a controlled tactile lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(0 34 69 / 16%); border-radius: 4px; background: #0067e7; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgb(91 125 160 / 4%), 0 1px 2px rgb(91 125 160 / 3%); font: 600 14px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { border-color: #023c9b; background: #023c9b; } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0067e7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action with visible structure and no resting lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #c8d2dc; border-radius: 4px; background: #f6f8fb; color: #002245; font: 600 14px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #eef2f6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0067e7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tertiary Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action that gains a tonal surface on interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-tertiary { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #002245; font: 600 14px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-tertiary:hover, .ds-btn-tertiary:active { background: #eef2f6; } .ds-btn-tertiary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0067e7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact field with an explicit border and high-visibility keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: #002245; font: 600 12px/16px 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #5e758d; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #002245; font: 400 14px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0067e7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat structural container for a scoped work area.
components.html:
Shipment review

Carrier details

Verify the required transport information before issue.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #c8d2dc; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #002245; font: 400 14px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-kicker { margin: 0; color: #3f556b; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 16px; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 22px; } .ds-panel p:last-child { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #3f556b; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Outlined textual status; color reinforces the label instead of replacing it.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 4px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #a68d5b; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #4f3422; font: 600 11px/16px 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Quiet navigation with a clear selected marker.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3eaf1; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 32px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #3f556b; font: 500 14px/20px inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button:hover { background: #eef2f6; } .ds-tabs .is-selected { color: #023c9b; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px #0067e7; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0067e7; outline-offset: -3px; }

narrative.overview:
FDS is a compact interface system for freight work that must stay legible while people review records, act on exceptions, and move work forward. Its visual language is deliberate rather than decorative: narrow, highly readable type; a small spacing scale; clear borders; and a single blue action signal make dense operational screens calm to scan.

The system is flat by default, with tactile feedback reserved for controls and overlays. That makes an action feel responsive without turning the application into a stack of floating cards. Route Blue marks meaningful action and focus; dark navy text carries the working content; pale neutral surfaces separate information without weakening hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Compact semantic typography for forms, tables, and record details.
Route Blue is reserved for action, focus, and selected state.
Borders and tonal surfaces establish structure before elevation.
Controls respond with light depth and clear state changes.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Use Route Blue for actionable or selected UI only; it should never become a general decoration color.

rules.name: The Compact Measure Rule
rules.body: Use the shared semantic roles instead of enlarging body text to create hierarchy; reserve larger headline treatment for Storybook's orientation pages.

rules.name: The Meaning-First Wrap Rule
rules.body: Preserve labels, field targets, and table columns when space narrows. Wrap actions and fields before reducing text or creating ambiguous icon-only controls.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: Persistent panels stay structurally flat. Add depth only when a control is actionable or a layer must clearly sit above the current task.

dos: Do use semantic color, type, spacing, and component tokens rather than primitive values in component code.
Do make action, selected, and keyboard-focus states unmistakable with Route Blue and visible focus treatment.
Do keep operational surfaces compact, bordered, and readable at narrow widths.
Do use tactile depth for interactive controls and active overlays only.
donts: Don't use Route Blue as a general decorative background or a substitute for hierarchy.
Don't create floating card stacks where a border or tonal surface already explains grouping.
Don't remove visible labels, keyboard focus, or status text to make a dense workflow look cleaner.
Don't bypass the shared 4px-based spacing and small-radius form language with one-off visual treatments.
